caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural structure resembling a small, ornate balcony or window projection set against a plain background. This structure has a semi-circular, domed canopy at the top, painted in a reddish-brown color with green and gold accents, and trimmed with a gold band and small scalloped white edge. The central section features a grid of two rows of three rectangular panels, each bordered in gold and filled with ornate pinkish floral and geometric motifs on a light blue background. Below the grid of panels is a balustrade with alternating vertical elongated diamond and rectangular shapes, decorated in red, green, gold, and blue with detailed patterns and small rose-like decorations. The base of the structure is tapered and rounded, painted in muted blue and white tones, with floral relief and gold trim at the rim. The entire structure is shaded to the left, indicating a light source from the right, and is drawn with fine, detailed lines and colored with soft, realistic shading.
title: Pulpit
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
